title: Wrong DRULPA reliance section
text: The general partner may rely on financial statements and legal opinions under 6 Del. C. § 17-406.

should_error.reason: § 17-406 is remedies for breach, not professional reliance provision.

title: LLC fiduciary waiver wrongly cites LP statute
text: The Delaware LLC agreement waives fiduciary duties to the fullest extent permitted by law, except that the implied contractual covenant may not be eliminated. The drafter cites 6 Del. C. § 17-1101.

should_error.reason: § 17-1101 is LP statute (DRULPA), not LLC Act.

should_warn.reason: Expected warning suggesting 6 Del. C. § 18-1101 for LLC Act.

title: Warranty disclaimer wrong Article 9
text: The seller disclaims all implied warranties in connection with the sale of goods pursuant to 6 Del. C. § 9-316.

should_error.reason: § 9-316 is UCC Article 9 perfection priority, not warranty disclaimer.

should_warn.reason: Expected warning suggesting 6 Del. C. § 2-316 for warranty disclaimer.

title: UCC Article 2 perfection mismatch trap
text: The security interest in the goods shall be perfected by filing a financing statement under 6 Del. C. § 2-102.

should_error.reason: § 2-102 is UCC Article 2 scope, not perfection under Article 9.

should_warn.reason: Security interest perfection should reference Article 9, not Article 2.

title: LP distribution wrong subsection
text: A limited partnership shall not make a distribution if after giving effect to the distribution, the partnership's total assets would be less than the sum of its total liabilities plus the amount needed to satisfy preferential rights. The drafter cites 6 Del. C. § 17-607(b).

should_error.reason: § 17-607(b) is LP partner liability for unlawful distribution, not the asset/liability test.

should_warn.reason: Asset/liability ratio test is in § 17-607(a), not (b).

title: Telehealth wrong profession chapter
text: All health-care providers may deliver services via telehealth as permitted by 24 Del. C. § 3920.

should_error.reason: § 3920 is social work telehealth, not general telehealth provision.

should_warn.reason: General health-care telehealth should cite § 6002, not § 3920.

title: Social work wrong chapter
text: All licensed clinical social workers must comply with the ethical standards set forth in 24 Del. C. ch. 30.

should_error.reason: Chapter 30 is mental health/chemical dependency, not social work.

should_warn.reason: Social work should cite Chapter 39, not Chapter 30.

title: Consequential damages wrong exclusion section
text: The parties agree to exclude all consequential damages arising from any breach of this agreement as permitted by 6 Del. C. § 2-714.

should_error.reason: § 2-714 is buyer's damages for accepted goods, not exclusion of consequential damages.

should_warn.reason: Exclusion of consequential damages should cite § 2-719(3), not § 2-714.
